scope: Adapted first Lakius boss. Source pixels, ANI names and durations are retained; HP, attack hit windows, AI, armor, stagger immunity and damage below are prototype tuning, not recovered client combat.
notes: Canonical source keys only: stay, move, attack1, damage1, damage2, down, moveback, sit, attacklong, attackheart. No fabricated dash/attack2/attack3 boss clips. attacklong540ms is retained in the source package but unused by this first boss AI.

Normal uses original410ms attack1; heavy uses original1100ms attackheart with its original850ms windup frame. The independent physics attack_clock defines new hit windows without editing ANI frame durations.

Attack start locks facing and ground position. One successful contact per attack instance. Heavy windup accepts HP damage but ignores knockback and hurt until850ms; active/recovery can be interrupted.
Normal hurt lasts0.18s, then0.25s ignores further stagger/knockback while still taking damage. Every heavy completion or active-phase interruption grants0.65s without pursuit or new attacks.
The red ground-plane warning is visible only during heavy windup and does not cover the vertical actor. Pause, menus, modal bag/dialog, inspection and travel freeze AI, warning and combat timers.
Hero hit shapes and200ms basic-attack buffer reuse adapted hall behavior. Successful hero hits add only profile.weapon_damage_bonus(), currently0/4, never the source item attack72.
route_hero_hp is the shared transient HP pool (max100). tower_boss_state is independent from first_encounter_state. Returning keeps HP/cleared and uses the authored safe boss spawn.
R uses WorldTravel.safe_reset, restores both HP pools and the normal/normal/heavy pattern, and never revokes historical chapter completion. This controller does not read or write profile files.
Only direct source attack-info contact tags KNIFE_HIT / SLASH_HIT_03 are played on actual successful contacts. No guessed attack/hurt/death voice dispatch.

Ghost Slash uses canonical hardattack18frames/950ms. Its150-450ms hit window,160px range,28px depth and44HP damage are explicit prototype adaptations; SourceSkillRuntime enforces the source6000ms cooldown. No original ACT hit schedule or attack formula is claimed.
